title: Stripe MCP server (mcp.stripe.com)
description: Side-effect classes for the 15 tools in the Tools table of Stripe's MCP docs. stripe_api_write is one tool for every POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE method (refunds, voids, deletes), so it carries write+spend+destructive: gate it by role and approval, not by tool name alone. Stripe has not published input schemas for the Treasury money tools, so no spend amount path is set: a currency budget denies them (limit_N:unknown_spend, fail-closed) and a count budget on class spend works.

sources.what: Tools table (names, descriptions, Human confirmation badges), Supported API methods, auth (OAuth, agent API keys)

stripe_api_search.note: searches the API method catalog, not account data

stripe_api_read.note: any GET method: customers, charges, payment methods, payouts, Issuing cards

stripe_api_write.note: any POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE method; includes Create refund (Human confirmation), void/finalize invoice, create Checkout Session

atlas_company_formation.note: prepares or resumes an Atlas incorporation application; paying, signing and submitting happen in the Dashboard

convert_currency.note: moves funds between currencies in a Treasury account (Human confirmation)

send_money.note: sends money from a Treasury account to a recipient (Human confirmation)

transfer_money.note: moves money between supported Stripe balances (Human confirmation)
